blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate.
This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment.
We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture.
For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies.
Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence.
MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD.
Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD.
These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.
Collectively, the findings establish that grounding diagnostic inference in structured clinical criteria yields models that are accurate, interpretable, uncertainty-aware, and better aligned with the evidence-based reasoning used in clinical practice.
blocks.zh:
临床诊断本质上是一个有条理的推理过程,然而现有的深层学习模型往往绕过这种结构,将图像特征直接映射到疾病标签上,而没有明确询问临床医生系统评价的形态和纹理标准.
这限制了诊断透明度,并可能损害安全的临床部署。
我们介绍了MedCORE(医学标准 -- -- 面向理性和证据),这是一个结构化的诊断框架,在视觉语言结构中实施临床推理。
对于每个输入图像,MedCORE将诊断过程分解成临床定义的标准,在空间上将每个标准分解为诊断相关的图像区域,通过多尺度的表示来编码证据,能够捕捉宏观结构特征和微观文字病理特征,并使用一个图形注意网络来完善标准表示,该网络明确模拟标准之间的依赖性.
标准表述进一步与临床文本描述符相匹配,通过分级视觉原型来强化,并使用不确定性校正加权法进行汇总,以比例折扣低自信诊断证据.
MedCORE通过三种临床多样的成像模式得到验证,包括2018年国际标准行业分类的皮肤损伤分类、BUSI的乳房超声波损伤特征鉴定和IDRID的糖尿病肾上腺病分级鉴定。
在数量上,MedCORE在2018年国际标准行业分类上达到89.2%的精度,85.7%的宏-F1和96.4%的AUC;在BUSI上达到96.1%的精度,95.2%的宏-F1和98.4%的AUC;在IDRID上达到84.3%的精度,80.2%的宏-F1和92.8%的AUC.
这些结果表明,相对于强大的有线电视新闻网、变压器、生物医学视觉语言、基于概念和以原型为基础的基线,情况持续改善。
调查结果共同确定,将诊断推论基于结构化的临床标准,产生准确,可解释,能识别不确定性的模型,并更好地与临床实践中采用的循证推理相配合.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image diagnosis is increasingly supported by deep visual models, yet the dominant formulation still treats diagnosis as a direct mapping from pixels to disease labels. This formulation has delivered strong classification performance, but it does not match the way clinicians usually justify a decision. A dermatologist does not simply assign a lesion category; she inspects asymmetry, border irregularity, colour variation, dermoscopic structures, vascular patterns and other clinically meaningful cues. Likewise, ultrasound and retinal diagnosis rely on structured visual evidence that is spatially localised, clinically named and often mutually dependent. For high-stakes clinical deployment, a diagnostic model should therefore expose not only what it predicts, but also which clinical criteria support the prediction, where those criteria are observed and how reliable each piece of evidence is.
blocks.zh: 医学影像诊断越来越得到深视觉模型的支持,然而主导配方仍然将诊断视为从像素到疾病标签的直接映射. 这种提法产生了很强的分类性能,但与临床医生通常为决定辩护的方式不符. 皮肤科医生并不简单地指定一个损伤类别;她检查不对称、边界不规则、颜色变化、皮肤结构、血管模式和其他临床有意义的提示。 同样地,超声波和视网膜诊断依赖于结构化的视觉证据,这些证据在空间上被定位,在临床上被命名,而且往往相互依赖. 因此,对于高摄取量的临床部署,诊断模型不仅应揭示其预测的内容,还应揭示哪些临床标准支持预测、这些标准在哪些地方得到遵守以及每一件证据的可靠性。

blocks.en:
Vision–language pre-training offers a natural route toward this goal. General models such as CLIP [ 22 ] and biomedical variants including GLoRIA [ 12 ] , BioViL [ 3 ] , MedKLIP [ 26 ] , KAD [ 32 ] , BiomedCLIP [ 31 ] and BiomedGPT [ 30 ] learn visual representations aligned with clinical or biomedical language. However, most of these methods rely on global image–text similarity, report-level supervision or weak region–word alignment. They may encode useful medical semantics, but the final classifier is often not forced to reason through explicit diagnostic criteria. Concept-based models address this limitation by inserting human-interpretable variables
between images and labels [ 14 , 29 , 20 , 28 , 23 ] . Recent medical approaches, including Explicd [ 9 ] , MICA [ 2 ] , AdaCBM [ 6 ] and Med-MICN [ 10 ] , show that clinical concepts can improve explanation quality. Yet three gaps remain. First, criteria are commonly represented as text anchors or concept tokens without explicit criterion-specific spatial grounding. Second, criteria are often treated independently, although clinical signs are correlated. Third, aggregation usually ignores criterion-level uncertainty, even when visual evidence is ambiguous or corrupted by imaging artefacts.
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言预训为实现这一目标提供了自然途径。 CLIP[22]和生物医学变体等一般型号,包括GLORIA [12],BioViL [3],MedKLIP [26],KAD [32],BiomedCLIP [31]和BiomedGPT [30] 学习与临床或生物医学语言相适应的视觉表现. 然而,大多数这些方法都依赖于全球图像-文本相似性、报告层面的监督或薄弱的区域-字词一致。 它们可能编码有用的医学语义,但最终的分类器往往不会通过明确的诊断标准强制进行推理. 基于概念的模型通过插入人可解释变量来解决这一局限性
在图像和标签之间[14、29、20、28、23]。 近期的医学方法,包括Excled [9],MICA [2],AdaCBM [6]和Med-MICN [10],表明临床概念可以提高解释质量. 然而,仍然存在三个差距。 首先,标准通常作为文本锚地或概念标志来体现,而没有明确的具体标准空间定位。 第二,标准往往得到独立的处理,尽管临床症状是相互关联的。 第三,聚合通常忽略标准层次的不确定性,即使视觉证据模棱两可或被成像工艺所腐蚀.

blocks.en: We propose MedCORE , a criteria-grounded framework for interpretable medical image classification. Instead of predicting labels directly from global image features, MedCORE decomposes diagnosis into clinically meaningful criteria. Each criterion is paired with a clinical text anchor encoded by the frozen BiomedCLIP text encoder, while a frozen BiomedCLIP visual backbone provides dense image tokens. Lightweight trainable modules then learn criterion-specific visual representations without updating the backbone. To make these representations spatially meaningful, learned criterion queries generate attention maps over image tokens, allowing each criterion to focus on diagnostically relevant regions without requiring spatial supervision. Multi-scale criterion encoding further captures both coarse morphological structure and fine local texture.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 MeDCORE, 一个基于标准的框架 解释医学图像分类。 MeDCORE没有从全球图像特征直接预测出标签,而是将诊断分解为临床有意义的标准. 每个标准都与被冷冻的BiomedCLIP文本编码器所编码的临床文本锚相配;而被冷冻的BiomedCLIP视觉骨干则提供密集的图像符号. 轻量级可训练模块然后在不更新主干线的情况下学习特定标准视觉表现. 要使这些表示具有空间意义,所学到的标准查询在图像符号上产生注意地图,使每个标准都能够侧重于诊断相关区域而不需要空间监督. 多尺度标准编码进一步捕捉出粗糙的形态结构和精细的局部纹理.

blocks.en:
MedCORE further models diagnosis as structured evidence aggregation. A criterion dependency graph attention module [ 25 ] refines each criterion using related criteria, allowing clinically correlated signs to reinforce one another. A
class-wise visual prototype memory maintains discriminative evidence for each criterion and disease class, encouraging compact same-class representations and better separation across classes. Finally, an uncertainty head estimates the reliability of each criterion and down-weights ambiguous evidence before the final prediction. The model is trained with a three-term objective: cross-entropy for diagnostic classification, vision–language alignment to clinical text anchors and prototype-based discriminative learning.
blocks.zh:
MeDCORE进一步将诊断模型作为结构化的证据汇总. 一个标准依赖图关注模块[25]利用相关标准来细化每个标准,允许临床相关征兆相得益彰. A级
类可视化原型内存维持着对每个标准和疾病类的歧视性证据,鼓励紧凑的同级表现并更好的分级. 最后,一个不确定性头目在最后预测之前估计出每项标准以及下行重量模糊的证据的可靠性. 该模型的培训有三期目标:诊断分类的交叉切入,视觉-语言与临床文本锚地的对接和基于原型的歧视性学习.

blocks.en: We evaluate MedCORE on ISIC2018 skin lesion classification [ 7 ] , BUSI breast ultrasound classification [ 1 ] , and diabetic-retinopathy grading using IDRiD/RetinaMNIST [ 21 , 27 ] . These benchmarks span dermoscopy, ultrasound and retinal fundus imaging, enabling us to assess whether explicit clinical criteria, spatial grounding, relational reasoning, prototype reinforcement and uncertainty-calibrated aggregation improve both diagnostic performance and interpretability across heterogeneous imaging modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们根据国际标准行业分类2018皮肤损伤分类[7]、BUSI乳房超声波分类[1]以及使用IDRID/RetinaMINIST进行糖尿病-肾上腺病分级[21、27],对MedCORE进行评价。 这些基准覆盖了皮肤检查、超声波和视网膜成像,使我们能够评估明确的临床标准、空间地平面、关系推理、原型增强和不确定性校准汇总是否改善了诊断性能和各种成像模式的可解释性。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: 1. We formulate medical image diagnosis as grounded clinical-criteria reasoning, enabling evidence-level interpretation across dermoscopy, breast ultrasound and retinal fundus imaging. 2. We introduce criterion-aware spatial localisation with multi-scale criterion encoding, allowing each clinical criterion to attend to diagnostically relevant image regions and visual scales. 3. We model inter-criteria dependencies using graph attention and reinforce class discriminative evidence through criterion-wise visual prototype learning. 4. We propose uncertainty-calibrated criterion aggregation, reducing the influence of unreliable or ambiguous criteria in the final diagnostic decision. 5. We evaluate MedCORE across three clinically heterogeneous medical image benchmarks using quantitative comparison, qualitative visualisation and ablation analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 1. 我们将医疗图像诊断定为基于临床标准的推理,从而能够在整个皮肤镜、乳房超声波和视网膜成像方面进行证据层面的解释。 2. 我们采用具有多尺度标准编码的标准认识空间定位,使每个临床标准都能够处理诊断相关的图像区域和视觉尺度。 3. 我们利用图表关注来模拟标准之间的依赖性,并通过标准视觉原型学习来加强阶级歧视证据。 4. 我们提议以不确定性校正标准汇总,以减少最后诊断决定中不可靠或模棱两可标准的影响。 5. 我们通过定量比较、定性可视化和萎缩分析,对三种临床不同的医疗图像基准进行MeDCORE评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large-scale vision language pre-training has become a strong foundation for medical image analysis. GLoRIA [ 12 ] introduced global–local alignment between radiographs and reports for label-efficient recognition, while BioViL [ 3 ] exploited radiology text semantics to improve biomedical representation learning. MedKLIP [ 26 ] and KAD [ 32 ] inject medical knowledge into image–text pre-training, improving disease recognition and entity-level grounding in chest radiology. BiomedCLIP and BiomedGPT further extend biomedical vision language learning to broader image text corpora and diverse biomedical tasks [ 31 , 30 ] . These works provide powerful backbones, but their explanations are typically derived from global similarity, report tokens or disease entities. MedCORE uses a biomedical vision–language backbone differently: clinical text anchors define explicit diagnostic criteria, while visual evidence is spatially grounded, relationally refined and uncertainty-weighted before classification.
blocks.zh: 大规模视觉语言预训成为医学影像分析的坚实基础. GLORIA [12] 引入了全球-局部的放射图与报告之间的校正,以达到标签效率的识别,而BioViL [3] 则利用了放射学文本语义学来改进生物医学表现学的学习. MeDKLIP[26]和KAD[32]将医学知识注入图像-文本前培训,提高疾病识别和实体层面的胸腔放射学入地. BiomedCLIP和BiomedGPT进一步将生物医学视觉语言学习扩展至更广泛的图像文本corpora和多样的生物医学任务[31,30]. 这些作品提供了强大的骨干,但其解释一般取自全球相似性,报告符或疾病实体. MeDCORE使用生物医学视觉-语言主干不同:临床文本锚地定义了明确的诊断标准,而视觉证据则在空间上立足,关系上精炼,在分类前对不确定性进行加权.

blocks.en: Concept bottleneck models make predictions through human-understandable intermediate variables [ 14 ] . To reduce dependence on expensive concept annotations, recent post-hoc, label-free and language-guided CBMs use learned representations or language models to construct concept spaces [ 29 , 20 , 28 , 23 ] . In medical imaging, Explicd aligns visual concept tokens with diagnostic knowledge, MICA performs multi-level image–concept alignment for skin lesions, AdaCBM adapts CLIP-based CBMs for diagnosis, and Med-MICN aligns concept semantics with neural-symbolic and saliency explanations [ 9 , 2 , 6 , 10 ] . These methods show the value of clinical concepts, but most do not jointly address criterion-specific localisation, relationships among criteria and criterion-level uncertainty. MedCORE is designed around these three requirements.
blocks.zh: 概念瓶颈模型通过人可理解的中间变量来进行预测[14]. 为了减少对昂贵的概念说明的依赖,近期的后期、无标签和语言指导的建立信任措施利用学到的表述或语言模型构建概念空间[29、20、28、23]。 在医学成像中,Exliced将视觉概念符号与诊断知识相配合,MICA执行多层次图像——皮肤损伤概念相接,AdaCBM对基于CLIP的CFM进行诊断,而Med-MICN将概念语义与神经-同义和显要解释相配合[9,2,6,10]. 这些方法显示了临床概念的价值,但大多数方法并没有共同解决具体标准本地化,标准之间的关系以及标准层次的不确定性. MeDCORE是围绕这三项要求设计的.

blocks.en:
Spatial grounding is particularly important in medicine because many diagnostic criteria are valid only in specific regions. Segmentation and foundation models such as SAM and MedSAM demonstrate the value of spatial priors in natural and medical image analysis [ 13 , 18 ] . However, diagnostic classification often requires criterion-specific evidence rather than generic masks or image-level saliency. MedCORE therefore learns criterion-specific attention maps directly from dense visual tokens, localising evidence for each clinical criterion without requiring pixel-level criterion annotations. Clinical criteria are also relational: for example, asymmetry, border irregularity and colour variation may provide mutually reinforcing evidence in dermoscopy, while microaneurysms, haemorrhages and exudates jointly inform diabetic retinopathy severity. Graph attention networks provide a compact mechanism for learning such dependencies [ 25 ] . Prototype-based models such as PIP-Net and ProtoViT improve interpretability through visual prototypes [ 19 , 17 ] ; MedCORE instead uses class-wise prototypes as
criterion-level discriminative memory while keeping explanations organised around clinical criteria. Finally, recent work emphasizes the importance of uncertainty in medical image classification [ 4 ] . Rather than estimating only image-level confidence, MedCORE assigns uncertainty to each criterion and uses it to calibrate evidence aggregation.
blocks.zh:
空间定位在医学中特别重要,因为许多诊断标准只在具体区域有效。 SAM和MDSAM等分化和地基模型在自然和医学图像分析[13,18]中展示了空间前兆的价值. 然而,诊断分类往往需要具体标准的证据,而不是通用口罩或图像水平的突出性。 因此,MedCORE直接从密集的视觉符号中学习出针对具体标准的关注地图,将每个临床标准的证据定位,而不需要像素级标准说明. 临床标准也是关系性的:例如不对称,边界不规则和颜色相变可能在皮肤镜检查中提供相得益彰的证据,而微神经瘤,出血和外出则共同为糖尿病肾上腺病严重性提供了信息. 图表关注网络为学习这种依赖性提供了一个紧凑的机制[25]。 基于原型的模型,如PIP-Net和ProtoViT通过视觉原型改进可解释性[19,17];MedCORE转而使用类型为:
标准层面的歧视记忆,同时保留围绕临床标准组织的解释。 最后,最近的工作强调医疗形象分类的不确定性的重要性[4]. MeDCORE不只估计图像级的置信度,而是给每个标准分配不确定性,并用它来校正证据汇总.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Clinically guided interpretable medical image classification framework. Input images are encoded using a frozen BioMedCLIP ViT-B/16 backbone, while clinical criterion queries extract localized evidence. The extracted evidence is refined through multi-scale encoding and graph attention reasoning with clinical priors. The model outputs diagnosis probabilities, criterion reliability scores, uncertainty estimates, and interpretable heatmaps.
blocks.zh: 图1:临床指导可解释医学影像分类框架. 输入图像使用被冻结的BioMedCLIP VIT-B/16主干线进行编码,而临床标准查询则提取出局部证据. 所取出的证据通过与临床前科的多尺度编码和图注推理得到完善. 模型输出诊断概率,标准可靠性分数,不确定性估计和可解释热图.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en:
Let 𝐈 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} denote a medical image and y ∈ { 1 , … , C } y\in\{1,\ldots,C\} its ground-truth disease label.
Rather than learning a direct mapping f : 𝐈 ↦ y f:\mathbf{I}\mapsto y , MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic decision into K K dataset-specific clinical criteria { c k } k = 1 K \{c_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , each representing a morphological or textural property that clinicians systematically evaluate ( e.g , asymmetry and border irregularity in dermoscopy; shape and margin in breast ultrasound; microaneurysms and haemorrhages in diabetic retinopathy grading).
The model evaluates each criterion independently, explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies, and aggregates evidence into a final diagnosis proportionally weighted by per-criterion confidence.

blocks.zh: 4 实验分析

blocks.en:
We evaluate MedCORE on three public medical image benchmarks spanning dermoscopy, breast ultrasound, and retinal fundus imaging. These datasets cover clinically distinct diagnostic settings and allow us to test whether criteria-grounded reasoning generalizes across lesion morphology, sonographic appearance, and retinal pathology.
ISIC 2018 [ 7 ] is a dermoscopic skin lesion dataset designed for automated skin lesion analysis and melanoma-related diagnosis. It contains lesion images with diagnostic categories and is well suited for criteria such as asymmetry, border irregularity, colour variation, dermoscopic structures, and vascular patterns, which are central to dermatological visual assessment.
BUSI [ 1 ] is a breast ultrasound dataset containing normal, benign, and malignant cases. It captures grayscale sonographic appearances of breast tissue and lesions, making it suitable for BI-RADS-inspired criteria such as lesion shape, margin characteristics, internal echo pattern, posterior acoustic features, and lesion orientation.
IDRiD [ 21 ] is a retinal fundus image dataset for diabetic retinopathy analysis. It
provides image-level disease severity information and lesion annotations for typical diabetic retinopathy findings, making it appropriate for ETDRS-aligned criteria such as microaneurysms, haemorrhages, hard exudates, soft exudates, and neovascularisation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了MedCORE 三个公共医疗影像基准 包括皮肤检查、乳房超声波和视网膜基金成像 这些数据集涵盖了临床上截然不同的诊断环境,并使我们能够测试基于标准的推理是否概括了各种损伤形态、声学外观和视网膜病理学。
ISIC 2018 [7]是一个皮肤外皮损伤数据集,旨在进行自动化皮肤外皮损伤分析和与黑色素瘤有关的诊断. 它包含有诊断类别的损伤图像,非常适合不对称,边界不规则,颜色变异,皮肤结构,血管模式等标准,这些是皮肤视觉评估的核心.
BUSI [1]是一个乳房超声波数据集,包含正常的,良性的和恶性的病例. 它捕捉出乳腺组织和损伤的灰色相声外观,使其适合受BI-RADS启发的标准,如损伤形状,边距特征,内回声模式,后相声特征,以及损伤取向等.
IDRID [21]是用于糖尿病肾上腺病分析的视网膜基金图象数据集. 这个
为典型的糖尿病肾上腺病诊断提供图像级的疾病严重性信息和损伤说明,使之适合ETDRS相适应的标准,如微神经瘤、出血、硬出血、软出血和新血管化。

blocks.en: We evaluate MedCORE on three representative medical image classification tasks covering different imaging modalities and diagnostic criteria: dermoscopic lesion classification, breast ultrasound classification, and diabetic retinopathy grading. The evaluated datasets are ISIC 2018 [ 7 ] , BUSI [ 1 ] , and IDRiD [ 21 ] . These datasets were selected because their diagnostic processes naturally depend on structured clinical criteria rather than a single global image pattern. Table 1 summarizes the task definitions and the clinical criteria used by MedCORE for each dataset.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Baseline Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基准方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare MedCORE with representative CNN, transformer, biomedical vision–language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines. CNN baselines include DenseNet–121 [ 11 ] , ResNet-50 [ 15 ] , and EfficientNet-B0 [ 24 ] . Transformer baselines include ViT-B/16 [ 8 ] and Swin-T [ 16 ] . To assess the benefit of clinical-criterion reasoning beyond biomedical pretraining alone, we include BiomedCLIP [ 31 ] with linear probing and fine-tuning. We also compare with Concept Bottleneck Models [ 14 ] and ProtoPNet [ 5 ] , which provide interpretable intermediate concepts or prototypes.
blocks.zh: 我们比较MeDCORE与有代表性的CNN、变压器、生物医学视觉-语言、概念和原型基线。 CNN的基线包括:DenseNet–121 [11],ResNet-50 [15],和高效网-B0 [24]. 变压器基线包括:VIT-B/16 [8]和Swin-T [16]. 为了评估临床-标准推理在生物医学预训之外的好处,我们把BiomedCLIP[31] 包括了线性检测和微调. 我们还与提供可解释的中间概念或原型的概念Bottleneck Models[14]和ProtoPNet[5]进行比较.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the complete classification results. MedCORE achieves the best performance across all three datasets, obtaining an average Macro-F1 of 87.0%. Compared with BiomedCLIP fine-tuning, MedCORE improves Macro-F1 by 3.3 percentage points on ISIC 2018, 2.4 percentage points on BUSI, and 3.7 percentage points on IDRiD. These gains indicate that the improvement does not come only from using a strong biomedical visual backbone; rather, explicit clinical-criterion localization, inter-criterion reasoning, and uncertainty-calibrated aggregation provide additional benefits.
blocks.zh: 表2报告完整的分类结果。 MeDCORE在所有三个数据集中都取得了最佳的性能,平均获得87.0%的Macro-F1. 与BiomedCLIP微调相比,MedCORE在2018年国际标准行业分类上将Macro-F1改进了3.3个百分点,在BUSI上改进了2.4个百分点,在IDRID上改进了3.7个百分点. 这些进展表明,改进不仅仅来自使用强大的生物医学视觉主干;相反,明确的临床标准本地化、标准间推理和不确定性校正汇总提供了额外的好处。

blocks.en: The largest absolute improvement is observed on IDRiD, where grading diabetic retinopathy depends on multiple interacting lesion types. This supports the motivation for graph-based inter-criterion reasoning. The improvement on ISIC 2018 also shows that decomposing lesion diagnosis into ABCD-inspired criteria provides stronger supervision than global visual classification. BUSI obtains the highest absolute scores, suggesting that the BI-RADS-inspired criterion set captures diagnostically meaningful ultrasound patterns.
blocks.zh: 在IDRID上观察到了最大的绝对改进,其中分级的糖尿病复发性取决于多种相互作用的损伤类型. 这支持了基于图的间标推理的动机. 2018年国际标准行业分类的改进还表明,将损伤诊断分解为ABCD启发性标准比全球视觉分类提供了更强有力的监督。 BUSI获得最高的绝对分数,暗示BI-RADS启发式标准集能捕捉诊断有意义的超声波模式.

blocks.en: The largest degradation occurs when replacing criterion-level reasoning with a single global feature representation, which reduces average Macro-F1 by 3.4 percentage points. This confirms that the proposed clinical decomposition is central to MedCORE. Removing criterion localization produces the second largest drop of 2.9 percentage points, showing that different clinical criteria require spatially distinct evidence. Removing GAT reasoning decreases Macro-F1 by 2.0 percentage points, indicating that dependencies among clinical findings are useful for diagnosis. The multi-scale encoder and uncertainty weighting each contribute 1.7 percentage points, demonstrating the importance of combining macro-structural and micro-textural evidence and suppressing unreliable criterion predictions. Vision–language alignment and prototype reinforcement provide smaller but consistent gains, suggesting that clinical semantic grounding and class-wise visual prototypes regularize the criterion feature space.
blocks.zh: 最大的退化发生在用单一的全球特征代表来取代标准级推理时,它使平均Macro-F1减少了3.4个百分点. 这证实了拟议的临床分解是MedCORE的核心. 删除标准本地化产生2.9个百分点的第二大下降,表明不同的临床标准需要空间上截然不同的证据. 取消GAT推理将Macro-F1降低2.0个百分点,表明临床发现的依赖性对诊断有用. 多尺度的编码器和不确定性权重各贡献了1.7个百分点,证明了将宏观结构证据和微观结构证据结合起来并压制不可靠的标准预测的重要性. Vision - 语言对接和原型加固提供了较小但一致的收益,表明临床语义地平面和分级视觉原型使标准特征空间规范化.

blocks.en: The poor performance at K = 1 K=1 indicates that a single global representation is insufficient to capture diverse diagnostic evidence. Increasing K K to 3 improves performance because the model can separate multiple clinical cues. The best result is obtained at K = 5 K=5 , which matches the manually defined clinical criterion set for each dataset. Increasing K K beyond 5 slightly reduces performance, likely because additional criteria become redundant, weakly defined, or noisy, making criterion localization and graph reasoning less stable. This result supports the use of a compact clinically motivated criterion set rather than an excessively large number of latent concepts.

blocks.en: BiomedCLIP-FT is consistently below the diagonal, indicating over-confidence: its predicted confidence is higher than its empirical accuracy. This effect is especially visible at high confidence, where the empirical accuracy at 0.95 confidence is only 0.83. In contrast, MedCORE reaches 0.93 empirical accuracy at the same confidence level. Using the plotted bins with equal weighting, the mean absolute calibration gap is approximately 8.2% for BiomedCLIP-FT and 1.2% for MedCORE. This improvement is consistent with the uncertainty-calibrated aggregation mechanism, which reduces the influence of unreliable criteria before producing the final prediction.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和未来方向

blocks.en:
We presented MedCORE, a criteria-grounded framework for interpretable medical image diagnosis.
Instead of relying on a direct image-to-label prediction pipeline, MedCORE decomposes diagnosis into clinically meaningful criteria, localises criterion-specific evidence, refines inter-criteria relationships with graph attention, and aggregates evidence using uncertainty-calibrated weighting.
By combining frozen biomedical vision–language representations with lightweight criterion reasoning, visual prototype reinforcement, and text-aligned supervision, MedCORE improves both diagnostic performance and explanatory structure across dermoscopy, breast ultrasound, and retinal fundus imaging benchmarks.
Experiments on ISIC 2018, BUSI, and IDRiD show that MedCORE achieves stronger accuracy, macro-F1, and AUC than CNN, Transformer, vision–language, concept bottleneck, and prototype-based baselines.
More importantly, the model provides criterion-level evidence, reliability scores, uncertainty estimates, and spatial heatmaps, making its predictions more transparent and clinically interpretable.
Future work will extend MedCORE to larger multi-centre datasets, incorporate expert-validated criterion annotations, and study its calibration and usefulness in real clinical decision-support settings.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了MeDCORE,这是可解释医学形象诊断的标准框架。
MeDCORE不依靠直接的图像到标签预测管道,而是将诊断分解成临床有意义的标准,将特定标准的证据本地化,将标准间关系与图注意度加以细化,并采用不确定性校正加权法来汇总证据.
MeDCORE将冷冻的生物医学视觉 — — 语言表达与轻量级标准推理、视觉原型强化和文本相通的监管相结合,改善了诊断性能和整个皮肤镜、乳房超声和视网膜基金成像基准的解释结构。
2018年ISIC,BUSI,IDRID的实验显示,MedCORE比CNN,"变形器",视觉语言,概念瓶颈,和原型基准更能实现更强的精度,宏-F1和AUC.
更重要的是,该模型提供了标准级的证据,可靠性分数,不确定性估计,以及空间热图,使其预测更加透明,临床上可以解释.
今后的工作将扩大MedCORE,使之包括更大的多中心数据集,纳入经专家验证的标准说明,并研究其校准和在真正的临床决策支持环境中的有用性。
